text: A BINAP catalyst hydrogenated an aryl ketone under 20 bar H2 in THF at 25 C for 12 h, giving 93% yield and 97.5% ee.

Substrate A was converted under 10 bar H2 to give 80% yield and 82% ee.
Substrate B was converted under 50 bar H2 to give 95% yield and 96% ee.
Using Josiphos in toluene at 40 C, the imine hydrogenation was performed at 1.5 MPa H2 for 18 h and afforded 91% yield and 94% ee.
